fact: The digital transformation ministry's communique, reported 22 July 2026, says SIGMAP's programming phase is operational since early 2026 while tender-file management and electronic bid submission are in testing.
The ministry reports SIGMAP used by 200 contracting authorities and 91 procurement commissions with over 600 users, and 274 annual procurement plans and 179 annual purchasing plans published on it.

The digital ministry's steering committee reviewed progress on SIGMAP, the national public procurement system, which it says will start taking ministries' procurement plans on 15 December 2025, with full launch planned for early 2026.
ARMP and the digital ministry launched the national public procurement portal on 3 December 2024, carrying procurement plans, tender announcements and results.
The World Bank says its USD 50 million financing approved 3 June 2025 will support deployment of Mauritania's e-GP system, developed under the Digital Transformation for Africa Program.
